profile.headline: Chief Software Developer for New SaaS services at Honda North America
profile.summary:
Executive leader with in-depth experience in digital and business transformations. Digitizing business functions and transforms underlying business models by utilizing cloud-based services and improving the customer experience. Skilled at remote work solutions driving collaboration and increasing communication. Specialist at delivering business needs and system performance. Significant experience in security and business continuity planning. Focused on adding value by creating top-line growth while reduce bottom line cost. Creates high-performing organizations, bringing process, structure and discipline without stifling flexibility, speed, creativity, or throughput. Has significant broad-based skills, tested and proven in positions ranging from CIO at Fortune 500 companies to startups. Routinely deployed into growth, transformational and turnaround roles.                                                              

C level executive, CIO, CTO or VP IT        Education: MBA, BSEE

Noteworthy Career Achievements:

•	Created the first Multi-Carrier Multi-Product sales platform for the Life and Health insurance market resulting in over $100M in new premiums being sold during the last 3 years.
•	Created new customer on-boarding process and implemented Salesforce.com resulting in a 376% improvement in cycle time to bring on new clients and driving 23% top-line growth.
•	Initiated and optimized search engine placement for keywords to top 6 rankings at Google. This resulted in a 403% increase in partnership revenue and top-line growth for the corporation.
•	Led 100+ Business Process Management (BPM) and Business Process Automation (BPA) efforts resulting in 8%- 376% improvements in value for various business processes.


Specialties: 
* Cost optimization 
* Cloud Computing 
* Technology enabling communication and collaboration
* Software as a Service (SaaS) 
* IT Strategy 
* Remote work Solutions 
* Digitizing business functions
* Business Intelligence/Data analytics 
* Business Continuity 
* Coaching/Mentoring/Developing staff

positions.title: Chief Software Developer
positions.description: Lead the development effort for new SaaS services at Honda North America

positions.title: CIO
positions.description: New and unique SaaS platform for the Gig Economy. Responsibilities include investor relations, business development, system architecture, design and development.

positions.title: Chief Technology Officer - Interim
positions.description: Created a new SaaS platform to manage nurse staffing. Responsibilities included successfully assisting in raising $10M in equity funding, system architecture, design and development along with supporting business development.

positions.title: Chief Information Technology Officer- Contract
positions.description: Created and managed Dental Practice Management SaaS Solution. Directed a team of 20 both onshore and off with budget of $3.5M. Responsibilities included daily operations, system architecture, design and development, along with client system integration.

positions.title: CIO
positions.description: Created and manage a multi-carrier, multi-product, SaaS insurance sales platform. Directed a team of 35 with an annual budget of $5M. Responsibilities included business development, daily operations, system architecture, design and development, along with client system integration.

positions.title: Vice President & CIO
positions.description: Managed the day to day operations of a shared services and business process automation/management consulting organization. Directed a team of 40 with an annual budget of $9M. Responsibilities included business development, daily operations, system architecture, design and development along with client system integration.

positions.title: Chief Technical Advisor
positions.description: Provided strategic and tactical guidance to allow the MIS department to leapfrog into assisting the company to offer better, faster and more effective services to its customers.

positions.title: Vice President & CTO
positions.description: Developed SaaS products for small business.

positions.title: CIO
positions.description: Lead all development and delivery of IT functions. Responsible for all aspects of IT, including long range strategic planning, budgeting, systems development, daily operations and continuous improvement.

positions.title: VP & CIO
positions.description:
Vice President and CIO – Corporate

Lead all development and delivery of IT functions. Responsible for all aspects of IT from long range strategic planning, budgeting, systems development, daily operations and continuous improvement. Refocused department from a reactive technology focus to providing services to our business. Increased all systems performance from adequate or slow to fast. Significantly reduced maintenance and monthly service costs. Achieved 100% availability on critical business systems.

•	Delivered all major new system enhancements/functions on schedule and in budget. This resulted in a 400% increase in partnership revenue for the corporation.
•	Architected and rebuilt whole website. The web site performance went from slow to fast as measured by Alexa.com while achieving 100% availability.

positions.title: Director IT – Integrated Services and Technology Solutions
positions.description: Managed the successful implementation of combining the multiple divisional IT organizations from an un-integrated, unstable, reactive environment into a pro-active single centralized IT unit that meets the businesses needs for performance and cost.

positions.title: Director IT – Integrated Services and Technology Solutions
positions.description: Implemented operations reviews and introduced metrics for all organizations. This has resulted in the group going from an ad hoc, reactive to a stable, managed proactive organization. Conducted Ops reviews quarterly with the Global CIO and monthly with the CTO. Responsible for coordinating the IT portion of Sarbanes-Oxley compliance, which involves  identifying IT controls, testing and resolving all known gaps on an ongoing basis. The result was a successful attestation in 2005. Coordinated the creation of all internal SLA agreements with the business units.
